d: Pakistan U19 secured a thrilling 3-wicket victory over India U19 in a tense ACC Men's U19 Asia Cup encounter. Despite Arjun Rajput’s brilliant 107 off 85 balls helping India recover from 22/3 to post 208, Pakistan’s bowlers kept things tight with three wickets each for Ali Raza, Rizwanullah and Niqab Shafiq. India fought back by reducing Pakistan to 61/5, but Hamza Zahoor’s unbeaten 100 off 108 balls, alongside a crucial 107-run sixth-wicket partnership, guided Pakistan to victory at 209/7 with 11 balls to spare.
